businessUrls.title: Yelp business URLs
businessUrls.description: One or more Yelp business page URLs. Example: https://www.yelp.com/biz/the-halal-guys-new-york

businessUrl.title: Single business URL (alternative)
businessUrl.description: Single Yelp business URL. Used only if businessUrls is empty.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews to extract
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per business. Prevents runaway charges on businesses with thousands of reviews.

language.title: Review language filter
language.description: Only return reviews written in this language. Use 'ALL' for every language.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Yelp blocks datacenter IPs aggressively. If you see captchas, switch to RESIDENTIAL.
